=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (2026-06-08 via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/functions/{array,aggregate}.html) ===

• ARRAY (a): slice(x, start, length) → array — start 1-based; negative start = from end; subsets array starting from index 'start' with length 'length'. array_distinct(x) → array. array_sort(x) → array (ASC default); array_sort(array(T), function(T, T, int)) → array(T) custom comparator. array_intersect/union/except all 2-arg (x, y) → array. cardinality(x) → bigint. reverse(x) → array. contains(x, element) → boolean. transform(array(T), function(T, U)) → array(U). filter(array(T), function(T, boolean)) → array(T). reduce(array(T), initialState S, inputFunction(S, T, S), outputFunction(S, R)) → R (4-arg). array_join(x, delimiter) → varchar AND array_join(x, delimiter, null_replacement) → varchar. element_at(array(E), index) → E (1-based; element_at(arr, 0) is a parse error in Trino). array_position(x, element) → bigint.
• SEQUENCE / DATE-SPINE (b): sequence(start, stop) → array AND sequence(start, stop, step) → array. Integer step for int forms; INTERVAL DAY TO SECOND or INTERVAL YEAR TO MONTH step for date/timestamp forms. Both bounds INCLUSIVE. Default step +1 if start <= stop, else -1 (int form). NO generate_series in Trino — use sequence() + UNNEST. UNNEST(sequence(...)) AS t(col) is the canonical row-spine / date-spine generator.
• ZIP (c): zip(array1, array2[, ...]) → array(row). zip_with(array(T), array(U), function(T, U, R)) → array(R). map_zip_with(map(K, V1), map(K, V2), function(K, V1, V2, V3)) → map(K, V3) — exists in Trino 467 but ZERO mentions in resources (synthesizable-WATCH-ITEM; no false claim).
• AGGREGATE (d): min_by(x, y) → [same as x]: value of x associated with MIN of y. max_by(x, y) → [same as x]: value of x associated with MAX of y. 3-arg forms min_by(x, y, n) / max_by(x, y, n) → array<[same as x]> return the top/bottom n values. ONE row per GROUP BY group (NOT per input row — that's the window-function distinction). arbitrary(x) → [same as input]: arbitrary non-null value; identical to any_value(). any_value(x) → [same as input]: alias for arbitrary. count(*) → bigint: number of input rows. count(x) → bigint: number of non-null inputs (exception list — returns 0 not NULL for zero inputs). count_if(x) → bigint: number of TRUE inputs. approx_distinct(x) → bigint; approx_distinct(x, e) → bigint with error tolerance e.
